EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN.C031: It separates the mechanical channel from the informational channel in on-chain exchange-flow metrics. These metrics are widely cited but rarely identified. Either outcome constrains how on-chain flow observables should be timed in later cards.

MECHANISM_REGION: Holders who move BTC on-chain to a Binance deposit address in order to dispose of it cannot place spot orders until the exchange credits the deposit at a fixed confirmation depth K. If such inflows are motivated by disposal, aggressor selling pressure should be timed to the credit-eligible block rather than to the first-inclusion block. The reason is that the confirmation rule is a hard constraint on when the coins become usable.
MISSING_OBSERVABLE: as-of-dated Binance BTC deposit address cluster labels
block first-seen arrival timestamps as distinct from miner-set header timestamps
historical Binance BTC deposit confirmation count by effective date

EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN.C024: It adds an order-book determinant of cross-asset pass-through to the library. This separates liquidity-driven beta variation from the correlation-level structure already mapped under D4 and D10.

MECHANISM_REGION: Cross-asset market makers and relative-value desks that quote ETH and BTC perps and offset inventory across them transmit BTC shocks into ETH. When ETH near-touch depth is thin relative to BTC, each relative to its own trailing level, a BTC-originated shock meets less resting liquidity in ETH, so ETH's pass-through beta over the following hours should be higher. This inventory constraint binds in the high-volatility regime.
MISSING_OBSERVABLE: Binance USD-M bookDepth snapshots for BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT with verified start date, snapshot cadence and gap list
Near-touch depth within 0.5 percent and 1 percent of mid at hourly cadence for both perpetuals

EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN.C005: Moderate. It identifies derivative availability as a liquidity-supply mechanism in the cross-section, which no prior card isolated.

MECHANISM_REGION: On BTC stress days, makers in spot names lacking a same-asset Binance perpetual cannot offset inventory and hit risk limits, so they widen effective spreads relative to matched names with perpetual cover.
MISSING_OBSERVABLE: delisting or settlement timestamp of each Binance USD-M perpetual per base asset
effective launch timestamp of each Binance USD-M perpetual per base asset, including delisted perpetuals

EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN.C007: Moderate. It tests whether on-chain capital movement adds to shock recovery beyond the price and volume conditioning of D8, and clarifies whether exchange-label point-in-time work is worth funding.

MECHANISM_REGION: Within liquidation-driven down shocks, a net on-chain USDT inflow to exchange deposit addresses marks discount-absorbing capital in transit. Because of transfer latency it reaches the book once forced flow is exhausted, enlarging the 6h recovery.
MISSING_OBSERVABLE: exchange deposit and hot-wallet address labels with first public attribution dates
pinned byte-exact USDT transfer log extracts for Ethereum and Tron

EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN.C037: It tests a holder-behaviour mechanism that is separate from return-only effects in the crypto spot cross-section.

MECHANISM_REGION: Disposition-prone holders, a large share of alt spot holders, realize gains too early and hold losses. Names whose price is far above holders' turnover-weighted cost basis face realization supply that holds the price below its clearing level, followed by a catch-up drift. Names far below cost basis face supply as the price approaches break-even.
MISSING_OBSERVABLE: point-in-time daily circulating supply per token
